Priya (Product): Heads-up: forced-fallback policies and streaming frame v2 are GA on Hosted API. Rolling now; full regional coverage expected within ~3 hours. Please review rollout notes and runbook changes below. :megaphone:

Jon (Runtime): What does forced-fallback do in practice?

Priya (Product): New behavior: router can now proactively force a cheaper compatible variant (quantized or smaller shard) when cost or capacity signals hit thresholds. It's opt-in per-route via route config or request header X-Redwood-Fallback: enabled|disabled. Also streaming frame v2 reduces jitter and includes frame-level sequence ids for reordering. Backwards-compatible but clients that parse frames should be updated.

Rae (SRE): Rollout plan? Canary region and key metrics?

Priya (Product): Canary now in ap-southeast-1 for 30m, then staged ramp. Watch forced_fallback.rate, fallback.latency_delta, stream_v2.parse_errors. Pager if forced_fallback.rate > 5% for 10m or parse_errors spike.

DeployBot: deploy started: hosted-router v5.18 + stream-proxy v2.3 -> canary(ap-southeast-1) at 1860001400. Logs: https://deploys.internal/redwood/hosted-router/5.18

Jon (Runtime): Runtime notes: forced-fallback enforces compatibility checks (tokenizer match, max_seq) before steering; metric router.forced_fallback.reason carries strings like "qkv_mismatch" or "capacity_pressure". Stream v2 adds frame_seq and stream_trace_id metadata to SSE frames.

Hannah (Docs): I need exact header examples and a minimal parsing snippet for frame v2. Also migration guidance for SDKs.

Priya (Product): Header examples: X-Redwood-Fallback: enabled, X-Redwood-Priority: cost|latency|balanced. Example JSON payload below. Migration note: clients reading SSE should accept additional fields and keep graceful parsing for unknown keys.

Priya (Product): Example curl (streaming v2 + forced fallback enabled):
```
curl -N https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream/toolcall \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Fallback: enabled" \
  -d '{"model":"mosaic-7b","prompt":"Summarize","tool_calling":"adaptive"}'
```

Jon (Runtime): Ops note: forced-fallback will emit router.events with "fallback_initiated" and the selected_variant. We added a short-lived circuit (60s) to avoid flip-flop between variants under unstable load.

Rae (SRE): New alerts planned: forced_fallback.rate > 3% for 15m -> page, stream_v2.parse_errors > 0.5% for 10m -> page. I'll add dashboards for router.forced_fallback.count, fallback.latency_delta_p95, stream.frame_seq_gap.

DeployBot: canary completed: hosted-router v5.18 -> ap-southeast-1 OK (1860002300). Next: ramp to eu-central-1 at +25m.

Hannah (Docs): I'll publish an SDK migration note and an example parser snippet for frame_seq reordering (JS + Python) and add sample error handling for parse_errors. ETA: 2 hours.

Priya (Product): Support notes: new error codes: 4905 = forced-fallback-notice (informational), 4906 = forced-fallback-unavailable (fallback was preferred but no compatible variants). Add to support runbook with suggested mitigations: lower concurrency or change routing priority.

Jon (Runtime): Minor runtime tweak: bumped default fallback circuit timeout from 30s -> 60s to reduce churn. No client action required.

Rae (SRE): I'll update runbooks and post support snippet in #support after docs land. Also adding a short playbook for reverting forced-fallback per-route if needed.

DeployBot: staged ramp: hosted-router v5.18 -> eu-central-1 OK (1860003100). Next: us-west-2 at +40m.

Hannah (Docs): Draft published: https://internal.redwood/docs/stream-v2-fallbacks (includes parsing examples and header reference). Filing sample-app PR for sse-client update: https://git.internal/redwood/sample-apps/pull/220

Priya (Product): Thank you all. Please react with :thumbsup: when tasks are complete. We'll monitor metrics and post any anomalies to #incidents.

Jon (Runtime): :thumbsup:

Rae (SRE): :thumbsup:

Hannah (Docs): :thumbsup:

Priya (Product): Rollout complete across regions at 1860004440. If you notice customer-impacting issues, ping @oncall or me immediately.
